---
title: "callouty-theorem cases"
format:
  html:
    filters:
      - callouty-theorem
  pdf:
    filters:
      - callouty-theorem

callouty-theorem:
  thm: # explicit appearance: outside HTML still a minimal box
    callout:
      type: note
      appearance: default
  lem: # override-title off: never a bar titled "Note"
    override-title: false
    callout:
      type: note
  def:
    callout:
      type: note
  proof:
    callout:
      type: note
      appearance: default
      collapse: true
  remark: # override-title off on a proof-like type: never a bar titled "Note"
    override-title: false
    callout:
      type: tip
---

Used by `check-cases.js` (HTML) and `check-pdf.js` (PDF), after `quarto render tests/cases.qmd`: no case may show a bar titled "Note" or "Tip" above a body that prints its own heading.
It is excluded from the project render (`render:` in `_quarto-website.yml`), so render it by hand.

:::{#thm-explicit}
## Explicit appearance

Every even number above two is not prime.
:::

:::{#lem-no-override}
## Override off

One is not prime.
:::

:::{#def-plain}
## Plain

A prime is a number with two divisors.
:::

:::{#thm-div-default appearance="default"}
## Per-div appearance

A per-div `appearance="default"` must not bring the bar back outside HTML.
:::

:::{.remark}
## Remark with override off

A remark whose title is not overridden.
:::

:::{.proof}
## Proof (see [@eq-inner])

By [@eq-inner].

$$
2 + 2 = 4
$$ {#eq-inner}
:::
